scientific_integrity.mathematical_scope: Finite intrinsic Čech nerve on all 3-subsets of a 6-set and its geometric complement quotient.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Finite exact cellular-boundary and orbit computations with a fully executable verifier, and a covering-space proof for the integral fundamental group.
scientific_integrity.scientific_limitations: Only quotient fundamental group, first integral homology, rational homology in all degrees and the two rational complement traces are established. Higher integral homology, equivariant homotopy, and infinite-family extensions are not established. Original unquotiented Betti numbers were previously reported.

title: Complement quotient of a six-point three-subset Čech complex
